_comment: Single source of truth mapping a framework model-tier label (the Claude Code model aliases used in agent frontmatter) to the concrete model each harness runs. Only the Codex adapter (bin/sync-codex-adapter.sh) reads this file today, through the 'codex' column. The pi and opencode adapters do not read it. A harness adapter that needs a model mapping adds its own column here (e.g. 'pi', 'opencode') rather than hardcoding a second mapping. Per AgDR-0087 (reasoning agents require a frontier-tier model), keep each harness's 'opus' row on that harness's strongest available model — never downgrade the reasoning tier when adding a harness. Absent tier or column falls back to the label unchanged.
